name: momo-pipeline
description: A guided PPT production pipeline with exact-template priority, a packaged Dingxin template, browser preview, component comments, approval-gated export, and final QA.

interface.shortDescription: Design, preview, export, and QA presentation decks.
interface.longDescription: A structured PPT production workflow: resolve the exact topic and template, confirm the Design Studio intake, build a browser preview for slide and component comments, apply comments on demand, then export and clean an editable PPTX after approval. Includes the current blue Dingxin Digital Intelligence template.
defaultPrompt: Create a PPT with momo-pipeline; preview it and wait for approval before export.
Redesign this deck with momo-pipeline and show the browser preview first.
Use my company template in momo-pipeline and preserve its layout and styling.
Apply the pending open-slide component comments, rebuild the preview, and do not export yet.
